pairs.registryProposal: Upward lesson for unreached-decisions-pin-nothing / pin-the-call-not-the-name: in this repo the same 'parity' failure appears in two contexts as a test that holds a hand-copied literal of the far side's list (vault safeModeUtils.test.ts:37, src/api/__tests__/enums.test.ts:29), while src/features/notepad/__tests__/notepadCapParity.test.ts:22 is the conformant form - it parses the Rust const at run time, throws when the needle is missing (:23) and asserts a non-empty parse (:30). A decision rule worth stating outright: a cross-language parity test that carries a copy of the far side is a third copy, not a pin; it must read the far side's source, or be mirrored by a reciprocal pin on the far side whose failure names the near file (src-tauri/src/engine/db_query.rs:3344 does the latter for READ_SHAPED_WRITES). notepadCapParity.test.ts is a candidate node--pin-the-call-not-the-name application.
